insights: The design system leverages a high-contrast dark theme with extensive use of semi-transparent white overlays (white/10, white/20) to create depth and hierarchy without introducing new colors.
Button variations follow a consistent pill-to-rounded-lg radius pattern, with CTAs using more pronounced styling (filled backgrounds) while secondary actions use ghost/transparent treatments.

Motion design emphasizes smooth, cubic-bezier eased transitions (0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) with marquee animations for social proof elements and wave animations for the voice recording visualization, creating a cohesive motion language.
